t2.thesis: SNDK will likely beat again, but the memory complex has repeatedly sold beats at what the market treats as peak-cycle earnings, so a rise from entry open to exit open is slightly less likely than not.
reasons: Semis cluster base rate (0.479) is below the overall buy-everything rate.
SNDK fell at the open after 3 of its last 4 prints despite 14-75% EPS surprises, including -16% in August on a 13.7% beat.
Consensus of $46.41 already sits above the top of the $44-46 guide, and the buy-side whisper is likely higher still.
A 5x forward P/E and a stock 40% off its high point to peak-margin skepticism (84.6% gross margin); Seagate sold off on 10/28 despite a beat and raise.
Upside offsets: SK Hynix's demand-above-supply-through-2030 call, NBM contract momentum, positive EPS revisions, and a depressed setup after a -20% month.
t2.deciding_variable: FQ2 guidance relative to buy-side expectations, especially revenue well above roughly $12B and gross margin holding at or above 84%, plus commentary on how long NAND pricing stays strong.

prior.from: I3 by_cluster semis t0_hit 0.479 (n=434); overall ~0.54 and AMC 0.538 noted as an upper anchor

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. That earnings report (October 29, 2026) hasn't happened yet as of today (October 28, 2026), and it's past my knowledge cutoff, so I have no information on how SNDK's stock reacted.
t2.moved_from_prior: Down about 2 points from 0.48. The consistent sell-the-beat history and the high bar set above guidance outweigh the supportive SK Hynix read-through and the oversold positioning, because the rally on the snapshot day lifts the entry price.

theses.expected: Beat and raise, but the stock fades on peak-margin fears
theses.mechanism: Gross margin plateaus around 84-85% and investors extrapolate peak pricing, repeating the August pattern
theses.wrong_if: FQ2 guide implies further sequential margin expansion and more than 15% revenue growth

theses.mechanism: A guide well above the street, several new NBM signings and a large buyback reframe earnings as durable, with short-covering after the 40% drawdown
theses.wrong_if: The guide is only in line with or below the $50+ EPS whisper

theses.mechanism: Results land in line with the elevated whisper, the move stays inside the ~8% implied range, and direction is close to a coin flip
theses.wrong_if: Guidance diverges materially from the street

key_observations: FQ2 revenue and EPS guide versus a street of roughly $46+ and higher whispers
Gross margin trajectory and pricing commentary (any sign of NAND price deceleration)
Datacenter revenue growth and new NBM agreements, including any prepayments or contract liabilities
Read-through from the broader tech and memory tape on 10/29-10/30, and whether the 10/28 rally holds into the entry open
